beats.say: Elijah Wood played Frodo Baggins across three massive fantasy films.
Visual effects supervisor Jim Rygiel oversaw the visual illusion work across the trilogy.
Sean Astin, Dominic Monaghan and Billy Boyd played the other central hobbits in The Fellowship of the Ring.
Ian Holm also played Bilbo Baggins in both The Two Towers and The Return of the King.
The three films were shot simultaneously in New Zealand from 11 October 1999 until 22 December 2000.
Filming all three movies together meant every visual trick had to work consistently across the entire production timeline.
That was Film Explained: subscribe for more movie secrets, because it all started when...
